svg.font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Segoe UI',sans-serif
svg.text: Next word: Zhiyi's next-word models guess the next word
first word right (dark) / among the 5 (light) %, higher is better
4,941 rows (the word's first characters typed, the rest to guess)
(d) Chinese · mid-text completion (the cursor inside the text)
3,789 rows (the text before and after the cursor, the word in between)
(f) Chinese · next word, single characters too
3,548 rows (the text's words in their natural mix, about 42% single characters such as 是 / 我; only 1120 gives them)
Test sets: the word the text really has next after its context (Chinese: jieba words of 2-6 characters; English: the next word,
lowercased). The model gives 5 words: the text's word first is "first right", among them "among the 5". Many continuations
make sense and only the text's counts, so all scores are low.
zhen-mini-next-preview = the released single 4-bit file, ml-flash-next-preview-1114 = PyTorch fp32
(the released single files checked on 300 rows a set); beam 8;
with the n-gram, the n-gram's 50 words are scored by the model too and the two are weighted (the weight tuned on dev). The English
trigram is counted from the English training text. Completion: ng1017's 200 most likely next words that start with the typed
characters. Qwen3-1.7B-Base is the teacher whose top words were the soft labels (1.7B parameters, beam 32), for reference.
Mid-text: the test rows whose text goes on after the word, that text as the right side of the cursor (Chinese 4 characters on
median, English 23). The 1116 models = PyTorch fp32 (the released files checked on 300 rows a set); the teacher = its 30 words
from the left side rescored by "word + right side". zh-lite-next-preview-1120 = PyTorch fp32 (the released files checked on 300
rows a set); in (f) a word may be one character, everywhere else words of 2+ characters.
